caption: The drawing depicts a single brown dog with a saddle placed on its back. The dog is illustrated in a standing position, facing toward the left side of the image. Its fur is rendered in shades of light and dark brown, with some lighter areas on the underside of its body and legs. The dog wears a reddish-brown collar around its neck. The saddle on the dog's back is saddle-brown in color, with an attached decorative blanket or cloth beneath it that is olive green and bordered with a deep red, featuring a gold decorative pattern. The background of the image is plain and off-white, without any additional objects or scenery.
title: Carousel Dog
